questions.prompt: Which of these rivers flow through Europe?
questions.fact: The Danube passes through ten countries, more than any other river in the world.

questions.prompt: Which of these are gases at room temperature?
questions.fact: Mercury and bromine are the only two elements that are liquid in a warm room.

questions.prompt: How many litres of milk does it take to make one kilogram of cheese?
questions.fact: About ten litres for a hard cheese. Most of the milk drains away as whey.

questions.prompt: How many teeth does an adult human usually have?
questions.route: Count your own: 16 along the top and 16 along the bottom.
questions.fact: 32, counting the four wisdom teeth that many people never grow at all.

questions.prompt: Which part of the plant is cinnamon?
questions.hint: It is peeled off in strips and curls up as it dries.
questions.fact: Cinnamon is the inner bark of a tree. The strips curl into quills as they dry out.

questions.prompt: What is the chemical symbol for gold?
questions.hint: It comes from the Latin word for gold, aurum.
questions.fact: Ag, silver, comes from the Latin argentum, which is also where Argentina got its name.
